meta.prompt: Help me pick a laptop with a short question flow, one question at a time, with progress (Question 1 of 3) and a Back button. Question 1: what I use it for (School or study, Work and office, Gaming, Creative projects). Question 2 depends on it: for Gaming ask "What do you play?" with Competitive esports or Big open-world titles; otherwise ask what matters most (All-day battery, A big screen and keyboard, As light as possible). Question 3: budget (Under $800, $800 to $1,500, Over $1,500). End on one recommendation with two reasons that repeat my answers and a Start over button: Gaming gets the Volt 16 Gaming at $1,399, Creative projects the Studio 14 Pro at $1,799, and anyone else the Slate 13 at $649 if the budget is under $800, otherwise the Aero 14 at $1,099.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Find your laptop" "Three quick questions" icon:"laptop_mac" status:"Step 1 of 3"
  state use=""
  state play=""
  state matters=""
  state budget=""
  state step=1
  let pick = use=="Gaming" ? "Volt 16 Gaming" : use=="Creative projects" ? "Studio 14 Pro" : (budget=="Under $800" ? "Slate 13" : "Aero 14")
  let price = use=="Gaming" ? "$1,399" : use=="Creative projects" ? "$1,799" : (budget=="Under $800" ? "$649" : "$1,099")
  let why1 = "Fits your use: "+use
  let why2 = "Within your budget: "+budget
  if step==1
    SectionLabel "Question 1 of 3" "What for?"
    Paragraph "What will you mostly use it for?"
    Segments =use options:["School or study","Work and office","Gaming","Creative projects"] -> step=2
  if step==2 && use=="Gaming"
    SectionLabel "Question 2 of 3" "Gaming"
    OptionList "What do you play?" =play options:["Competitive esports","Big open-world titles"] -> step=3
  if step==2 && use!="Gaming"
    SectionLabel "Question 2 of 3" "Priorities"
    OptionList "What matters most?" =matters options:["All-day battery","A big screen and keyboard","As light as possible"] -> step=3
  if step==3
    SectionLabel "Question 3 of 3" "Budget"
    OptionList "What is your budget?" =budget options:["Under $800","$800 to $1,500","Over $1,500"] -> step=4
  if step>1 && step<4
    Row between
      ActionButton "Back" quiet -> step=step-1
      Text.caption "Step {step} of 3"
  if step==4
    ChatCard "Your pick" "Based on your answers" icon:"check_circle" status:"Done"
      Recommendation "{pick}" "Chosen for {use}, within {budget}." reasons:=[why1, why2] eyebrow:"Best match"
      TotalBar "Price" "Your recommendation" amount:"{price}" cta:"Start over" icon:"refresh" -> step=1; use=""; play=""; matters=""; budget=""
